sentences.text:
Dr.Pilcher Kety Minoo, vs The State Of Telangana, on 10
September, 2024

Author: B. Vijaysen Reddy
Bench: B. Vijaysen Reddy
 The Honourable Sri Justice B. Vijaysen Reddy
 Writ Petition No.24170 Of 2024
Order :

(ORAL) Ms. Athulya R. Krishnan, learned counsel, representing, Mr. G. Durga Charan, learned counsel for the petitioner, submitted that subsequent to filing of this writ petition, First Information Report (FIR) No.145 of 2024 has been registered for the offences punishable under Sections 498A,
406 read with Section 34 of IPC and Section 3 and 6 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 with Women Police Station, North Zone (Hyderabad) on the complaint of the petitioner dated 20.07.2024.
Therefore, the cause in the writ petition does not survive requiring any further adjudication.
2. Recording the aforesaid submissions of learned counsel for the petitioner, the writ petition is closed.
As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous applications, if any, pending in the writ petition stand closed.

B. VIJAYSEN REDDY, J September 10, 2024 MS Dr.Pilcher Kety Minoo, vs The State Of Telangana, on 10 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/187082207/
